title: Cellohood-analyses: analysis notebooks for the Cellohood paper
description: This repository contains the analysis notebooks and scripts reproducing the figures of the Cellohood paper, including the DLPFC benchmark, the CODEX mouse spleen benchmark, the IMMUcan NSCLC Panel 1/2 discovery analyses, and the Jackson et al. breast cancer generalization analysis.
